title: Commodities Director Jakarta
job_description:
Role: Commodities Director Jakarta 

Location: Jakarta 
Position Type: Full-time 
Reports to: Managing Director 

About AME Group 

AME Group is a leading provider of consulting and research services to the Metals & Mining and Energy industries. Drawing on more than 50 years of industry expertise, we deliver bespoke consulting engagements, subscription research, and software-as-a-service products to clients globally. 

Our Jakarta office houses a well-established team of approximately 30 staff and is one of the AME’s key global research hubs. From this office we deliver consulting services to clients across Indonesia and South East Asia, while contributing to AME's worldwide research output. 

About the Role 

We are seeking an experienced Commodities Director to lead the Jakarta research function, providing operational management, quality assurance, and quality control over the team's research output. 

Jakarta Research Analysts are primarily responsible for: 

Accurate capture of asset and company level information from a variety of public and proprietary sources. 

Producing regular commodity market research publications 

Contributing to consulting engagements for both Indonesian and international clients 

Execution of market balance, pricing and demand forecasting models 

A successful candidate would work closely with AME's global research commodity leads, CTO and Managing Director to ensure research output meets the quality standards required across the business. 

Key Responsibilities 

A successful Commodities Director will assure the quality of analyst research while providing feedback and development opportunities, to this end, the manager will be responsible for 

Overseeing the end-to-end production for data collection, modelling and report generation. Including prioritisation, assignment, tracking and completion of analysts' work. 

Work with software and data engineering team to develop dashboards and tracking tools. 

Check analysts' deliverables against defined standards (defined by product owners), including confirming consistency with AME’s methodologies. 

Provide structured QA and spot checks to analysts’ work, provide meaningful feedback and manage rework where required. 

Provide preventative guidance, such as identifying common mistakes and identifying opportunities for training, methodology or software improvements. 

Work closely with product owners to establish and measure KPIs for analysts. 

Qualification and Experience 

This role is in fundamental commodities research, analyzing physical commodity markets through supply and demand balances, pricing models, and site-level data. It is not a market research, consumer insights, or marketing analytics role. Candidates without direct experience in physical commodity markets analysis will not be progressed. 

Required 

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance, or Commerce 

10+ years of experience in fundamental commodities research, gained at a financial institution (investment bank, credit desk, hedge fund, private equity, asset manager, or trading house), the economics function of a consulting firm, or a specialist commodities research company. 

Demonstrated specialist analyst experience in at least one commodity (Coal or Nickel preferred) 

5+ years in a management, team leadership, or quality assurance capacity 

An entrepreneurial mindset, with a proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing research teams 

Highly Desirable 

Experience in finance, transactions, or corporate development within Mining, Energy, or Metals sectors 

Technical Skills 

Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience building and developing analyst teams 

Expertise in fundamental commodities analysis, supply and demand modelling, price forecasting, cost curve construction, and asset-level evaluation 

Demonstrated track record of producing written research and advisory output for clients (institutional investors, lenders, corporates, or government) 

Highly numerate, with advanced quantitative and analytical skills and strong attention to detail 

In depth knowledge of the global resources sector, with specialist expertise in at least one commodity (Coal or Nickel preferred) 

Fluent written and spoken English (essential)

What We Offer 

Modern, central office near to public transport and key amenities 

Competitive salary

13 months salary

Define product direction: Collect client feedback, regulatory requirements, and frontline insights. Turn them into User Stories and roadmap priorities that the engineering team can execute on.

Trilingual: Fluent in Mandarin, English, and Bahasa Indonesia. You move seamlessly between cultures and teams.

Hands-on with AI: You've actually used AI tools to build things — not just read about them. You know where AI shines and where it breaks.

A relentless communicator:** You're the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You over-communicate by design, not by accident.

Healthcare domain knowledge: Background in healthtech, clinical operations, or medical informatics. You understand real hospital workflows.

Experienced PM: 4+ years in product management. You know how to manage timelines, scope, trade-offs, and stakeholders under pressure.

Outgoing and high-energy: You build trust fast, thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable being the loudest voice in the room when alignment is needed.

Bachelor's degree or above** in a relevant field (CS, Engineering, Healthcare, Biomedical, or similar).

---

- Real ownership in a high-growth, cross-border healthcare AI company.

- Direct impact: Your work shapes products used by real doctors and patients across Indonesia.

- Global exposure: Work daily with teams across China and Southeast Asia.

You'll be at the intersection of AI and healthcare in one of the world's largest markets. This isn't a "manage Jira tickets" PM role — you'll prototype AI solutions with your own hands, sit in clinics to find real problems, and ship products that change how millions of people receive care.

Akurasi data laporan (target 100%).

Peningkatan tingkat konversi (conversion rate) pada kanal digital melalui rekomendasi analitik.

Job Description for Factory IT Business Analyst (BA)




II. Core Job Responsibilities




1. Business Research and Pain Point Identification: Go deep into the factory's production workshops and warehouse frontlines, fully familiarize yourself with the entire warehouse process of "receiving, storing, issuing, counting, and managing" (including purchase warehousing, production material picking, production material returning, sales outbound, inventory counting, etc.) and the entire production process (production order maintenance, bill of materials management, production reporting, production warehousing, etc.). Sort out the existing business processes, job responsibilities and collaboration models, accurately identify business pain points, bottlenecks and optimization spaces, and form a business research and analysis report.




2. Requirements Analysis and Document Conversion: Combine the results of business research, collaborate efficiently with business departments such as production, warehousing and purchasing, collect, sort out and analyze business requirements. Convert complex business scenarios and operation processes into clear, standardized and implementable IT requirement documents, including but not limited to Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Requirements Document (FRD), flow charts, use case diagrams, etc. Ensure that the requirement description is accurate, the logic is clear, it is consistent with the actual business scenario of the factory, and bridge the cognitive gap between the IT development team and the business departments.




3. Project Implementation and Requirement Control: Participate in the entire process of requirement review, solution design, test verification and launch promotion of factory IT systems (such as MES, WMS, ERP production/warehousing modules, etc.), follow up the progress of requirement implementation throughout the process, coordinate and solve the connection problems between business and IT during the project implementation, ensure that the system functions meet the business requirements, and improve business operation efficiency.




4. Process Optimization and System Iteration: Continuously track the operation effect of production and warehousing business processes and IT systems, put forward requirement optimization suggestions based on business changes (such as capacity improvement, process adjustment) and system usage feedback, and promote the iterative upgrading of IT systems; assist business departments in sorting out standardized business processes, realize "process reengineering" based on "online processes", and help improve business efficiency.




III. Job Qualifications




(I) Hard Requirements




1. Education and Major: Bachelor's degree or above, major in computer-related fields (Computer Science and Technology, Information Management and Information System, etc.), Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management and other related majors are preferred.




2. Work Experience: More than 3 years of relevant work experience as a factory IT Business Analyst (BA), must have business analysis experience related to factory warehouse management and production processes, be familiar with the entire process of factory production execution and warehouse management, and be able to independently complete business research, requirement analysis and requirement document writing.




3. Core Competencies: Possess strong requirement conversion ability, able to convert complex factory business scenarios (such as warehouse batch management, production material kitting analysis, inventory traceability, etc.) into standardized and implementable IT requirement documents; have clear logical thinking and problem analysis ability, able to quickly locate business pain points and put forward reasonable optimization solutions.




4. Successful Cases: At least 1 successful factory IT project case must be provided (which must include warehouse or production-related scenarios), clearly explaining the business analysis responsibilities undertaken in the project, the requirement conversion process and the project implementation results (such as quantifiable indicators such as process optimization efficiency, inventory accuracy improvement, energy consumption reduction, etc.), and the case must be true and traceable.

Role Overview

We are looking for a mid to senior-level consultant with hands-on Continuous Improvement (CI) experience to drive operational transformation across Southeast Asia.

This role is suited for individuals who have personally led and implemented improvement initiatives, delivering measurable results using Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma, or TPM methodologies.

You will work closely with senior leaders and frontline teams, structured and critical thinking, root cause problem-solving, and strong facilitation skills. The role demands the ability to operate in ambiguity and sustain impact over longer project cycles.

Lead and execute client projects across manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, construction, and services.

Diagnose operational issues through process mapping, KPI analysis, Gemba walks, and stakeholder interviews.

Design and implement Lean and Kaizen-based improvement strategies.

Facilitate VSM (Value Stream Mapping), problem-solving workshops, and Kaizen events.

Ensure successful delivery of measurable outcomes (e.g., lead time reduction, OEE improvement, cost savings).

Coach leaders and teams in problem-solving, daily management, and continuous improvement routines.

Present findings, roadmaps, and recommendations to client senior management with clarity and confidence.

Design and deliver engaging, contextualized training programs in Lean, Kaizen, TPM, and Six Sigma.

Support internal and client-side capability building through mentorship, train-the-trainer programs, and certification pathways.

4. Thought Leadership & Knowledge Development

Contribute to the development of training materials, toolkits, case studies, and methodologies.

Write articles or insights that build Kaizen Institute’s thought leadership in the region.

5. Internal Collaboration & Growth Support

Guide junior consultants and support onboarding of new hires.

Maintain clear records (timesheets, reports) and contribute to proposals, client pitches, and business development.

Assist with internal operations, especially where required for the Indonesia practice (e.g., HR/admin support).

 Skills & Competencies

Personal Attributes

Strong analytical thinker with practical problem-solving ability.

Self-driven, resilient, and results focused.

Enjoys engaging with people and driving cultural change.

Able to balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail.

Soft Skills

Excellent facilitation, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

Comfortable engaging both senior leadership and shopfloor teams.

Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (multilingual a plus).

Able to thrive in ambiguity and work independently.

Technical / Hard Skills

Project management experience with structured reporting and delivery.

Proficient in process analysis tools: VSM, A3, PDCA, RCA, standard work, etc.

Confident in developing executive-level slide decks and reports.

Visualization and workshop design (e.g., Miro, Lucidchart, PowerPoint).

Technical Tools

Must-have: PowerPoint, Excel, Word

Preferred: Minitab, Tableau/Power BI, Lucidchart/Visio, ThinkCell

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations, or Business Analytics; Master's preferred.

Certified in Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), TPM, or equivalent.

7–12 years of relevant experience, including:

Hands-on CI project implementation

Experience in consulting OR internal CI/OPEX roles

Experience across multiple industries preferred

Willingness to travel regionally for client engagements (typically 20–40%)

About Kaizen Institute

Kaizen Institute is a global leader in operational excellence and continuous improvement. With over 40 years of experience, we work with leading organizations to enhance productivity, drive transformation, and build high-performance cultures through Lean, TPM, and Kaizen™ methodologies.

We operate in more than 60 countries, serving clients across industries including manufacturing, healthcare, FMCG, logistics, pharmaceuticals, and construction. As we grow our footprint in Singapore and the broader Southeast Asia region, we are seeking a Consultant / Senior Consultant – Lean and Kaizen Transformation.


Our Approach to Hiring

We are building a high-caliber consulting team and maintain a selective hiring standard for this role. We focus on candidates with clear ownership of implementation and measurable impact, with a strong emphasis on long-term fit over speed.

Candidates whose experience is primarily advisory or support-based, without hands-on implementation ownership, are unlikely to be a strong fit for this role.

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. The Market Insights Team helps shape strategic and operational decisions in the company by providing compelling insights into industry developments, market movements and competitive dynamics in the various businesses that Grab operates - namely transport, food, payments, and platform services.

In this role, you will lead competitive intelligence efforts to inform Grab's strategic decisions. Able to speak both Bahasa & English.
2 years of professional experience in an analytical role (business analytics, data analyst, data science).
Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.

Deep familiarity with the ride-hailing and food delivery sectors.
A solid foundation in applied statistics.

title: Business Operations & Management Associate
job_description:
🚀 About the Role

We’re looking for a Business Operations & Management Associate who can sit in the middle of numbers, processes, and people.




This role is a mix of:

Operations execution (data, reports, accuracy), and

Management support (coordination, follow-up, making sure things actually get done).

You’ll act as a bridge between management and day-to-day operations — making sure plans don’t hanya berhenti di slide, tapi beneran kejadian di lapangan.

Most people will find this role too structured, too demanding, or too detailed.

We’re looking for the outliers who enjoy ownership, clarity, and measurable results.




🧩 What You’ll Be Doing

You will be the operational backbone that helps management run the business with clean data and disciplined execution.


Operational & Data Responsibilities:

Manage financial and performance calculations for internal programs (bonus, rewards, rebates, and other schemes).

Monitor and ensure data accuracy across systems (CRM, trading platforms, trackers, and internal reports).

Maintain structured trackers, logs, and documentation that management can rely on anytime.




Management & Coordination Responsibilities:

Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Business Development, Product, Finance, Back Office, Operations) to align data, processes, and timelines.

Help management track commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups across ongoing initiatives.

Prepare concise reports and summaries for management, turning raw data into clear insights and next steps.

Identify recurring operational issues and propose practical improvements (better SOPs, checklists, workflows, or templates).

What Success Looks Like (First 3 Months)


By month 3, we’ll consider you successful if:

All recurring reports and calculations under your scope are on time, accurate, and complete.

Operational discrepancies are spotted early, investigated, and closed within an agreed SLA.

Management can see and track ongoing operations more clearly because of your structure (trackers, follow-ups, summaries).

You’ve driven at least 1–2 small but real improvements in how we work (e.g., new process, better template, clearer flow).




Requirements (Must-Haves)

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field (minimum GPA 3.2).

1–3 years experience in business operations, finance, project coordination, or management support roles.

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivot tables, conditional formulas, basic modeling).

High attention to detail — you don’t tolerate messy numbers or unclear processes.

Proven ability to take ownership: you don’t just wait for instructions, you move things forward.

Comfortable in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with shifting priorities.

Willing to work on a shift-based schedule, including certain holidays when operations require it.

Based in Indonesia and willing to relocate if needed.

Proficient in English, both written and verbal, for business and professional communication.




Nice-to-Haves

Experience in brokerage, fintech, trading, or financial services.

Experience handling commissions, rebates, incentives, or performance-based rewards.

Experience coordinating between multiple departments and consolidating information for management.

Familiarity with CRM platforms, reporting tools, or basic BI tools is a plus.




This role is for you if:

You enjoy being the person who makes sure things actually get done, not just someone watching from the sidelines.

You like mixing numbers + structure + coordination in your daily work.

You want a role where you get exposure to management decisions, while still being hands-on in operations.

You get satisfaction from turning chaos into something that’s tracked, measurable, and under control.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Odoo Developer to take technical ownership of our Odoo ERP platform (ticketing, RFID, POS, Finance, Retail, F&B, Sales & Marketing). Key Responsibilities

Develop and customize Odoo modules (Python, XML, JS/QWeb) based on agreed functional specs (POS, Ticketing, RFID, Finance, Inventory, F&B, Marketing).

Maintain and refactor existing custom code delivered by the vendor to improve stability, readability, and performance.

Implement small to medium change requests (new fields, workflows, wizards, reports, dashboards) without over‑customizing core Odoo.




Bug Fixing & Production Support

Investigate and fix urgent bugs in WB’s custom Odoo code (including POS, ticket validation, refund logic, settlement flows).

Work with the Functional/Business Analyst to reproduce issues, isolate root causes (config vs data vs code), and provide clear technical explanations.

Implement hotfixes safely (using staging and rollback plans) and document all changes.




Integrations & Technical Troubleshooting

Build and maintain integrations between Odoo and external systems (OTAs, payment gateways/EDC, RFID/gate systems, e‑commerce, marketing tools).

Troubleshoot API failures, timeouts, and data sync issues; add monitoring and logging where needed.

Work with the technical lead on performance tuning (workers, caching, SQL queries) and environment-level issues.




Technical Design, Code Quality, & Documentation

Design solutions that respect Odoo architecture and keep a clean separation between custom modules and standard code.

Follow best practices for version control (Git), branching, code reviews, and deployment pipelines.

Produce and maintain technical documentation for custom modules, data models, and integrations.


Testing & Release Management

Write and maintain unit tests / basic automated tests where feasible; at a minimum, ensure robust manual test scripts for critical flows.

Support UAT: prepare test data, fix defects, and iterate quickly based on feedback from key users.

Participate in planning and executing releases (staging, smoke tests, rollback procedures).


Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Work closely with the Odoo Functional/Business Analyst to understand business requirements and constraints.

Coordinate with the external vendor on bigger changes, upgrades, and complex incidents, using your technical analysis to push for precise fixes.

Proactively suggest technical improvements that reduce downtime, simplify maintenance, and improve data quality.


Qualification:

3+ years of hands‑on experience as an Odoo Developer (or strong Python developer with at least 2 years focused on Odoo).

Solid experience building and customizing Odoo modules in Python (models, business logic) and XML/QWeb (views, reports).

Strong understanding of Odoo framework: ORM, security (record rules/access rights), workflows, scheduled actions, and multi‑company/multi‑currency concepts.

Experience integrating Odoo with external systems via REST APIs (JSON/XML), webhooks, or middleware.

Comfortable working with PostgreSQL (basic querying, indexing awareness, understanding of Odoo schema).

Familiarity with Git and standard SDLC practices (branching, merge requests, code review, tagging).

Proven track record of troubleshooting production issues in Odoo (performance, deadlocks, broken flows) and delivering stable fixes.

Able to communicate clearly in Bahasa Indonesia and working English; able to explain technical topics in simple terms to non‑technical colleagues.

About the role
We are looking for an IT Auditor to join our Assurance practice and work alongside financial audit engagement teams. In this role, you will be the go-to person for all IT-related audit procedures — from understanding a client's IT environment and mapping IT General Controls, to extracting journal entry data from complex ERP systems and drafting IT-related findings for management letters.

 You will be embedded in financial audit engagements across a range of industries (manufacturing, trading, financial services, and others), ensuring that IT risks relevant to the financial statements are properly identified, tested, and reported in accordance with applicable Standar Audit (SA) requirements.

 If you are looking to build deep, cross-industry experience at the intersection of technology and financial auditing, this is an excellent opportunity.

What you'll be doing

Evaluate clients' IT environments as part of the audit team's risk assessment under SA 315, including understanding IT General Controls (ITGCs) over access security, change management, IT operations, and program development.

Design and execute test procedures for ITGCs and IT Application Controls (input, processing, output controls; automated calculations; system-enforced segregation of duties) relevant to significant classes of transactions and account balances.

Perform Journal Entry Testing (JET) procedures in support of the engagement team's fraud risk response under SA 240 — including data extraction from ERP and core banking systems, completeness reconciliation, and analysis of non-standard or unusual entries.

Assist engagement teams in assessing IT-dependent controls, system-generated reports, and automated interfaces that the financial audit relies upon.

Draft clear, well-structured IT-related findings and recommendations for inclusion in management letters and communications with Those Charged with Governance (TCWG).

Stay current with developments in IT audit methodology, data analytics tools, and relevant regulatory requirements (including OJK regulations for regulated-industry clients).

We focus on holistic student success, leveraging AI-powered solutions to ensure that students are well-prepared for their careers. We're looking for individuals who share our vision and want to make a meaningful impact in the future of education.

As a Business Analyst, you will play a key role in designing and shaping end-to-end SaaS solutions for Kinobi’s clients. This role bridges business requirements and technical execution — ensuring proposed solutions are commercially viable, functionally clear, and technically feasible.
You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams across pre-sales and early delivery phases. While grounded in strong business analysis fundamentals, this role also involves contributing to high-level solution architecture and supporting technical solution decisions.

Act as the technical authority during pre-sales and solutioning, ensuring solutions align with product capabilities and implementation realities.

Guide proof-of-concepts (POCs) and demos, ensuring functional workflows and technical designs accurately reflect real-world use cases.

Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Implementation teams to ensure solutions are deliverable, scalable, and operationally sound.

Support audit and compliance requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, IMDA) by aligning solution designs with required security and regulatory standards.

Commercial & Operational Support

Maintain clear and structured solution documentation to support internal alignment and execution.

Provide insights and feedback to improve solution effectiveness, proposal success, and client satisfaction.

title: Principal Product Manager - Discovery and Personalisation
job_description:
The Principal Product Manager for Discovery & Personalisation will own how subscribers find, explore and return to The Economist's journalism across web and app. This is a senior, cross-cutting role spanning two closely related disciplines:

Discovery. Owning the on-platform representation of our content - search, navigation, browse patterns and conversational interfaces that allow users to interrogate the archive and find authoritative journalism efficiently. This includes keyword and semantic search, ranking and surfacing logic, and generative AI features such as Q&A, content summarisation and conversational discovery experiences. A key part of this work is establishing the evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop processes that ensure AI-powered features are grounded in user trust and consistent with our editorial brand.       

Personalisation. Owning the recommendation and ranking algorithms that drive browse-led experiences — helping subscribers decide what to read, watch or listen to next. This means defining the behavioural signals and contextual inputs that feed personalisation models, partnering with data science on model development and evaluation, and ensuring our systems support habit formation without narrowing editorial perspective.

 The role interfaces with Web, App, Data science, Editorial and Analytics teams.

Responsibilities

Own the vision and roadmap for Discovery & Personalisation across web and app.

Lead the evolution of keyword and semantic search, including relevance, ranking and result quality.

Own browse-led personalisation systems — defining the signals, models and decisioning logic that surface relevant, timely content for individual subscribers.

Lead the creation of generative AI features including Q&A, content summarisation, explainer and conversational discovery experiences that help users explore and connect our journalism.

Establish robust evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop processes to ensure AI-powered features are accurate, transparent and aligned with our editorial values.

Partner closely with data science on the definition, evaluation and iteration of ranking and recommendation models.

Maintain strong judgement around responsible, transparent and editorially-aligned personalisation — preserving journalistic breadth and integrity.

Work closely with Editorial to ensure discovery and personalisation reflect journalistic judgement and trust, and that the right feedback loops are in place.

Collaborate with Web and App teams to ensure consistent, high-quality implementation of discovery and personalisation experiences across platforms.

Define and track success metrics related to findability, relevance, engagement, habit formation and trust.

Communicate strategy, priorities and performance clearly to senior stakeholders across product, editorial and technology.

The ideal skills for this role are:

Builder: You have owned and shipped complex search, discovery, recommendation or personalisation systems in content-rich or subscription products.

AI-fluent: You have hands-on experience defining and evaluating generative AI features — you understand the product, trust and editorial considerations that make AI experiences succeed or fail.

Data-informed: Comfortable working with data scientists on ML-driven systems, evaluation frameworks and experimentation.

Product-led: Strong judgement in defining strategy, translating it into roadmaps, and delivering outcomes through cross-functional teams in lean environments.

Editorially-aware: Confident balancing user intent, algorithmic optimisation and editorial integrity.

Communicator: Able to explain complex systems and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaborative: Comfortable learning, iterating and working across disciplines — engineering, data science, design and editorial — in a fast-moving environment.

Domain knowledge

Search and discovery systems, including semantic retrieval, ranking and evaluation.

Personalisation systems, behavioral signals and experimentation.

Generative AI product development and conversational interface best practices.

Responsible AI, algorithmic transparency and human-in-the-loop design.

Metrics for discovery quality, relevance, user understanding and trust.

Subscription or habit-forming digital products.

Multi-format digital content environments.

Enthusiasm for The Economist's mission, journalism and global audience.

Paid Acquisition Strategy: Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display) to drive qualified signups and demo requests.

Product Management: Ability to write clear PRDs, define user stories, and prioritize features based on impact and effort. Familiarity with agile development workflows.

Communication: Excellent communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia (mandatory) and English (at least passive).

Experience: 2+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager, Growth PM, or Product Marketing Manager. SaaS or B2B background is a plus.

SaaS Industry Experience: Prior experience working in B2B SaaS, communication platforms, or CRM products.

title: Business Intelligence & Strategic Data Analyst
job_description:
Deskripsi Perusahaan 

PT  Waschen Alora Indonesia (Alora Group) adalah sebuah entitas induk perusahan yang memiliki core business di bidang jasa kebersihan, seperti: Laundry rumah sakit (Healtcare Laundry), Penyewaan linen rumah sakit (Linen Rental), Laundry untuk Perusahaan (Corporate Laundry), Laundry Retail (residence), Jasa kebersihan rumah (Home Care) dan Jasa Kebersihan Kantor (Office Care). 

Kami mengundang talenta terbaik yang memiliki dedikasi, berpikiran terbuka (growth mindset) dan loyalitas untuk pengembangan karir dan pengembangan bisnis demi kemajuan bersama di masa depan. Kami tidak mencari sekadar analis data. Kami mencari “arsitek pertumbuhan”, seseorang yang mampu mengubah data menjadi strategi, dan strategi menjadi dampak nyata.  Kami mencari “problem solver berbasis data”, seseorang yang mampu melihat pola di balik angka, memahami bisnis secara mendalam, dan mengubah insight menjadi keputusan strategis.

Di peran ini, Anda akan berada di jantung pengambilan keputusan memahami apa yang benar-benar bekerja, apa yang tidak, dan ke mana kita harus melangkah berikutnya.

Tanggung Jawab (Job Description)

Turn Data Into Strategic Insight

Melakukan analisis data dan riset pasar untuk memahami tren industri, kebutuhan pelanggan, posisi kompetitif perusahaan serta peluang dan area yang perlu ditingkatkan dalam operasional bisnis.

Melakukan riset dan analisis mendalam (in-depth analysis) terhadap customer, marketing metrics, competitor landscape, serta tren marketing terbaru untuk mengidentifikasi peluang dan menutup gap pada produk maupun funnel.

Menggali data operasional, data pelanggan, data pasar untuk menemukan pola, peluang, dan risiko yang tidak terlihat oleh orang lain. 

Drive Decision-Making

Menyajikan insight yang tajam dan relevan untuk membantu manajemen mengambil keputusan berbasis data, bukan asumsi.

Bertanggung jawab atas fungsi analitik dengan merancang strategi pelacakan (tracking), membangun kerangka pengukuran (measurement framework), serta memberikan insight yang jelas terkait aktivitas operasional dan marketing.

Berkolaborasi dengan tim lintas fungsi untuk memberikan insight yang mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis.

Solve Real Business Problems

Mengidentifikasi bottleneck, inefficiency, dan peluang growth dalam proses bisnis, lalu memberikan solusi yang actionable.

Mendukung pelaksanaan A/B testing dan desain eksperimen, memastikan setiap project dapat diukur dengan baik dan hasilnya valid secara statistik. 

Build Data-Driven System

Mengembangkan dashboard, model analitik, dan framework pengukuran yang menjadi fondasi pengambilan keputusan perusahaan.

Collaborate Across Functions

Bekerja lintas tim (Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product) untuk memastikan setiap strategi didukung oleh data yang solid.

Kualifikasi (Requirements)

Pendidikan minimal Diploma/Sarjana di bidang terkait (relevan).

Memiliki pengalaman bekerja minimal 1 s.d. 5 tahun dibidang data analyst dan business analyst (lebih diutamakan yang menguasai market research dan marketing analysis).

Mampu berpikir kritis dan sistematis serta mampu menghubungkan data dengan konteks bisnis.

Pengalaman dalam menggunakan alat analisis data (Google Analytics, Power BI, SQL, Python dan tools sejenisnya), termasuk kemampuan mengolah big data secara efisien.

Berpengalaman membuat dashboard menggunakan tools visualisasi data (Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI atau sejenisnya).

Memahami berbagai channel digital marketing (iklan berbayar, SEO, referral, pertumbuhan organik, kampanye CRM).

Memahami statistik, analisis tren, dan machine learning dasar.

Kemampuan untuk bekerja dengan data besar dan kompleks. 

Berpikir analitis, detail-oriented, serta mampu menyajikan data secara logis.

Komunikatif & kolaboratif, bisa bekerja sama dengan tim marketing, sales, dan operasional.

Lancar berbahasa Inggris.

Kompensani dan Benefit

Gaji dan tunjangan yang kompetitif dengan insentif (bonus) kinerja.

BPJS (Asuransi kesehatan).

Exposure langsung ke decision-making level.

Lingkungan kerja yang mendorong thinking, ownership, dan impact.

Kesempatan berkembang menjadi future leader di bidang data, business & strategy.

title: Business Lead And Data Analyst
job_description:
Business Lead And Data Analyst  – Cybersecurity and Cyberintelligence Platforms

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Company: PT. Mars Bumi Indonesia (ZENTARA)

Type: Full-Time | Onsite | Immediate Start

Industry: Cybersecurity, Intelligence, and Advanced Defense Technology







About ZENTARA

ZENTARA is Indonesia’s pioneering technology startup, revolutionizing Cybersecurity, Intelligence, and Defence through advanced AI and machine learning. Our four divisions Cybersecurity, Intelligence, Defence, and Research Labs collaborate to build secure, intelligent systems that protect critical infrastructure and empower data-driven decisions.




Role Overview

The Business Lead/Data Analyst is a hybrid role that bridges the gap between ZENTARA Labs technical capabilities and measurable business outcomes. You will define and track KPI/OKR across our product portfolio, build analytics, and reporting systems for government and enterprise clients, conduct competitive intelligence, and serve as the data-driven voice in design partner engagements.

This role works at the intersection of product and revenue team, translating technical performance data into strategic insights that inform product direction and partnership decisions. You will be instrumental in validating product hypotheses through real-world deployment data and supporting the design partner collaboration model that is central to how ZENTARA Labs builds products.







Key Responsibilities

Product Analytics & KPI Management

Build and maintain analytics dashboards tailored to enterprise and government client reporting requirements.

Develop data pipelines and reporting infrastructure to support product iteration cycles.

Create automated reporting systems that surface actionable insights for revenue and product teams.


Business Intelligence & Strategy

Conduct market analysis and competitive intelligence for strategic planning across APAC cybersecurity and defense technology markets.

Prepare data-driven business cases for new product initiatives and partnership opportunities.

Analyze client engagement data to identify expansion opportunities and inform go-to-market strategy.

Support the Labs leadership in executive reporting and board-level communications with clear and data-backed narratives.


Design Partner Engagement

Support design partner relationship with data-driven insights and hypothesis validation.

Work with the revenue team to translate partner feedback into quantitative product requirements.

Document and communicate design partner outcomes to internal stakeholders and leadership.

Operational Data Management

Develop data governance frameworks aligned with ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 compliance requirements.

Manage data collection, cleaning, and analysis workflows for partner/client environments.

Support AI/ML model evaluation with structured data for training and production validation.

Ensure all analytics outputs meet data sovereignty and classification requirements for enterprise and government deployments.







Qualifications

Must-Haves

3+ years experience in business intelligence, data analytics or a similar role.

Experience with Data Visualization tools and dashboard development (Tableau, Power BI, D3.js, etc)

Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear business narratives for non-technical stakeholders.

Strong written and verbal communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English.

Experience working in B2B enterprise or government-facing environments.

Comfort operating in fast-paced startup environments with evolving priorities and ambiguity.



Bonus Points

Experience with cybersecurity, defense technology, or intelligence analysis domains.

Familiarity with PostgreSQL and related extensions for analytical workloads.

Understanding of AI/ML model evaluations metrics and experiment tracking.

Exposure to compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 42001) or government security standards.

Background in product for SaaS or platform products.

Experience with Go, Python, or any backend systems that support data pipeline development.

Familiarity with air-gapped or restricted network deployment environments.







What You’ll Get

Ground-floor opportunity to join a rapidly scaling Labs division during a pivotal growth phase, with direct access to C-level leadership.

Competitive base salary + BPJS + THR + performance-based bonuses + training budget.

Access to technical mentorship, internal R&D initiatives, and exposure to cutting-edge cybersecurity platforms.

Agile team, fast execution cycles, and a no-politics environment focused on real-world impact.

Hybrid role with breadth by combining deep analytical work with strategic business engagement.

Work alongside product managers, AI/ML engineers and researchers building products at the frontier of cybersecurity and intelligence.

11. Teliti, logis, kritis terhadap data, dan berbasis fakta dalam pengambilan kesimpulan.

title: Associate Product Manager - Subs Growth and Lifecycle
job_description:
The Economist Group is the leading source of analysis on international business and world affairs. We deliver world-class, thought-provoking content through a range of formats, from web and app to print, conferences, film, and audio. What ties us together is the objectivity of our opinion, the originality of our insight, and our advocacy of economic and political freedom around the world.

As our digital subscription business grows, so does the importance of delivering thoughtful, frictionless, and value-driven experiences across the entire subscriber lifecycle.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated Associate Product Manager to join our Subscriber Growth & Lifecycle product pillar. In this role, you will support the continuous improvement of subscription journeys that maximise subscriber lifetime value and foster long-term loyalty across web and app.

This is a hands-on role with strong exposure to strategy and delivery. You will contribute to initiatives across retention, upgrades, and customer care, working closely with experienced product managers, engineers, analysts, marketers, and customer operations teams. It offers a valuable opportunity to develop deep expertise in subscription products, monetisation, and experimentation within a globally recognised media organisation.

What you’ll do

As the Associate Product Manager for Subscriber Growth & Lifecycle, you will be responsible for the following with support from more senior Product Managers:

Own and optimise the end-to-end subscriber journey: You will be the product manager for key in-life subscription experiences, including upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and re-engagement flows. You will continuously identify and address friction points, and champion a subscriber-first mindset in everything you do.

Drive monetisation and experimentation: You will develop and execute a roadmap of monetisation initiatives, including offers, add-ons, and subscription tiers. You will design and run experiments to optimise our upgrade and retention paywalls, and use data to inform our pricing and packaging strategies.

Innovate in customer care: You will partner with our Customer Care teams to redefine how we serve our subscribers. You will lead the development of our self-service and assisted service journeys, including implementing AI-powered bots and other automation technologies to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Champion a data-driven culture: You will define and analyse key metrics such as churn, upgrades, engagement, and customer satisfaction. You will use this data to measure the impact of your initiatives, identify new opportunities, and communicate your progress to stakeholders.

Lead with influence: You will write clear and compelling user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation. You will use your strong communication and collaboration skills to align your team and stakeholders around a shared vision and roadmap.

What you’ll bring

We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about building great products and eager to learn and grow. The ideal candidate will have:

A proven track record of driving results: You have at least 2 years of experience in product management or a similar role (such as Product Marketing or Product Analytics) with a focus on digital customer journeys. You can point to specific examples of how you have used offers, discounts, add-ons, or subscription tiers to achieve business goals.

A deep understanding of the subscriber lifecycle: You have experience with paywall campaigns, experiments, or launches across web and app. You are familiar with the key levers for driving subscriber engagement, retention, and lifetime value.

A strategic and analytical mindset: You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities. You have a structured, data-informed approach to problem-solving and prioritisation. You are proficient in using data to make decisions and measure success.

Exceptional collaboration and communication skills: You are a natural collaborator who can work effectively with designers, engineers, analysts, and operational teams. You can articulate your ideas clearly and persuasively, and you are a great listener.

A "go-getter" mindset with high autonomy: You are a self-starter who takes initiative and can run with things independently. While you will have support from senior PMs, you are comfortable taking the lead on projects, navigating ambiguity, and proactively pushing initiatives to completion.

Nice to have:

Experience managing monetisation for a B2C app and web product.

Exposure to monetisation automation, personalisation, or machine-learning-driven decisioning.

Familiarity with subscription platforms or lifecycle marketing tools (e.g., Zuora, SF).

Experience with data analysis and visualisation tools (e.g., Amplitude, Tableau, SQL).

Why this role matters

This is an opportunity to make a real impact on The Economist's future. By improving our in-life subscription experience, you will not only drive revenue growth but also help us build a more sustainable and resilient business. You will be at the heart of our efforts to create a lifelong relationship with our readers and to ensure that The Economist remains the world's leading source of analysis on international business and world affairs for generations to come.

Location:

This role is based in South East Asia.
